title: Account Infos — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: A ledger account in the finance system that payroll posts to — salary expense, accruals, the salary bank account and so on. Wage accounts, payroll areas and the journal voucher refer to accounts from this list.

fields.label: Code
fields.rules: Optional. Left blank, the next number is assigned when the record is saved. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html:
What it is. A short code that identifies this item in its list.

Example. 001

fields.label: NameEn
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in English.

fields.label: NameAr
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in Arabic.

fields.label: AccountType
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Account Type master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The kind of account in the finance system.

Example. Ledger

Why it matters. Printed as the account type beside the account on each journal voucher line, for the main account and the offset account alike.
